protocol: Exact 20-seed Bernoulli mixed-routing comparison between frozen midpoint thresholds (tau_mid calibrated on Dataset B) and 999-permutation stratified Szekely-Rizzo conditional energy testing (alpha=0.05). Same-gateway plans (B20_q3, B40_q7, S3_10_q3, S3_10_q7) match results/service_audit/routing.json bit-for-bit on tau_mid while adding exact conditional permutation rejection curves. Cross-gateway plans (S1_CF0_OR21_20_q3, S1_CF21_OR21_20_q3) quantify the drift-vs-sensitivity trade-off when enrollment and query traverse distinct gateways.
